prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent standalone pickaxe for an existing low-top-down fantasy pixel-art RPG, a clean master for both a small inventory icon and a hand-held tool sprite. The supplied images are STYLE/SCALE REFERENCES ONLY: Image1 is the actual peasant character, Image2 is the existing Iron Warmaul equipment, Image3 is the current sharp ore artwork. Do not draw any character, hand, rock or hammer from those references.
Draw ONE complete practical Iron Pickaxe, isolated on genuine transparent alpha. It must read immediately as a mining pickaxe: a broad gently arched forged iron head across the upper part of a straight slender wooden shaft. Both tapered metal ends are pointed and turn slightly downward; one pick point is longer and the opposite point is a little shorter, with the shaft securely passing through the thickened central eye. The head is metal, not a rock or crystal. Medium cool iron-grey metal with a few clear bevel highlight planes and darker underside; worn warm-brown wood shaft, a subtle darker lower gripping section and a small restrained metal collar at the head. Medieval handmade workmanship, upper-left light, the same low top-down south-facing projection as the reference equipment. Restrained dark contour and compact readable faceted shading matching the character. No ornate jewels, runes, ribbons, glow, sparks or oversized fantasy spikes.
Composition is upright, not a diagonal inventory pose: shaft vertical at the canvas horizontal center, head approximately horizontal with a shallow natural curve. Keep the two complete tips, the entire shaft and its rounded butt visible, with generous transparent margins. The head spans roughly 58 percent of the canvas width; the whole tool is roughly 76 percent of its height. The hand grip lies on the lower shaft, about 18 percent of the shaft length above the butt, but no hand is shown. Keep the silhouette simple enough to remain readable at 32-40 native pixels tall beside a 64px character. Avoid excessive hairline detail.
Render the underlying tool as sharp high-resolution clean linework with clearly separated small shade planes, for one controlled rasterization to the character's native pixel grid. Do not imitate enlarged coarse pixel blocks or blurry nearest-upscaled artwork. No airbrush, photographic metal, fuzzy edges, grain, dithering, gradients bleeding beyond the silhouette, halo or ground shadow. No terrain/base, neighboring fragments, extra tools, labels, lettering, UI, borders or checkerboard pattern. One square transparent PNG, only the whole Iron Pickaxe.
